outcome: Prevalence of neglected and non-consented care
Factors associated with neglected and non-consented care
cohort: 415 women giving birth in public health facilities in Central Tigray, Ethiopia
finding: The level of neglected and non-consented care during delivery was high (82.4% and 78.6% respectively), and associated factors included education level, mode of delivery, sex of healthcare provider, number of deliveries in the health center, history of ANC, and being a federal government employee.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery and sex of healthcare providers were associated with non-consented care.
